description: TradingNX Risk Manager helps traders check planned trades before entry. It calculates position size, risk amount, risk/reward, daily loss exposure, open risk exposure, rule violations, and a TradingNX Risk Score. It supports forex, metals, crypto, stocks, indices, futures, and CFDs. TradingNX is educational risk-management software only and does not provide buy, sell, hold, investment, or financial advice.
